messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Sertraline is a prescription medicine.
Sertraline is used to treat depression.
Sertraline is used to treat obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD).
Sertraline is used to treat panic disorders.
Sertraline is used to treat posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD).
Sertraline is used to treat social anxiety disorder.
Sertraline is used to treat premenstrual dysphoric disorder (PMDD).
It is sold under the brand name Zoloft.
Generic sertraline is widely available.
Sertraline belongs to a group of medicines called selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors, or SSRIs.
It increases serotonin activity in the brain.
It does this by blocking the reuptake of serotonin back into nerve cells.
Serotonin is a chemical messenger that nerve cells use to communicate.
By blocking reuptake, more serotonin stays available.
Sertraline has only very weak effects on the reuptake of norepinephrine and dopamine.
It does not block monoamine oxidase.
Sertraline is available as tablets (25 mg, 50 mg, and 100 mg).
It is available as an oral solution (20 mg/mL).
It is available as capsules (150 mg and 200 mg).

The relation 'has weak effect on' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug has minimal impact on the process or target specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

A. 'reduces effectiveness of': The subject drug may decrease the effectiveness or impact of the treatment or substance specified by the object entity.
B. 'does not act on': The subject drug does not exert its effects directly on the entity specified by the object entity.
C. 'has benefit': The subject drug has the benefit or therapeutic effect specified by the object entity.
D. 'reduced absorption by': The absorption of the subject drug is decreased due to the substance specified by the object entity.
E. 'has no harmful effects on': The subject drug does not cause harmful effects on the specified group or entity.
